info.title: Omnia Tasks API
info.description: Implemented /api/v1 task and personal integration-key routes. Integration read/write switches default closed. Responses processed by implemented handlers use no-store and an X-Request-Id; unsupported verbs can receive the Next.js framework default 405 response. On Vercel (VERCEL=1), any standard If-Match request header on any implemented API operation is rejected before dispatch or persistence with JSON 400 UNSUPPORTED_PRECONDITION_HEADER. Use X-Omnia-If-Match for conditional task updates; successful task responses retain ETag. Outside Vercel the standard header remains compatible.

TaskCreate.description: Standalone for API/MCP keys. Recurrence is accepted only for a verified browser user. A non-null recurrence sets the first task dueDate to recurrence.startDate, overriding any supplied dueDate. If the next slot exceeds ON_DATE or AFTER_COUNT bounds, the series starts inactive with nextOccurrenceDate:null. Standalone creation preserves the supplied dueDate.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Compatibility transport outside Vercel for the exact strong ETag. Supply this or X-Omnia-If-Match; equal values required if both are sent. On Vercel, any If-Match header returns JSON 400 UNSUPPORTED_PRECONDITION_HEADER before mutation: send only X-Omnia-If-Match. No wildcard or weak ETag.

parameters.name: X-Omnia-If-Match
parameters.description: Required version transport on Vercel; recommended elsewhere. Exact strong ETag from GET/POST/PATCH, preserving the full database updatedAt string. Outside Vercel this or If-Match is required, with equal values if both are present. Missing version returns 428. No wildcard or weak ETag.

patch.description: A strong version is required in X-Omnia-If-Match. Outside Vercel, If-Match is also accepted; if both are present they must be equal, otherwise 400. Both carry the exact ETag returned by GET/POST/PATCH and enforce the same database compare-and-swap. Missing version returns 428; a stale version returns JSON 412. On Vercel (VERCEL=1), any standard If-Match header is rejected with JSON 400 UNSUPPORTED_PRECONDITION_HEADER before dispatch or mutation, including when the alias is also present and equal. Send only X-Omnia-If-Match there. Successful responses retain ETag.
